prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: photorealistic winter weather variant for the Fungaroli place gallery.
Edit target: Image 1 is the ORIGINAL REAL photograph at assets/zones/antrodoco-hd.webp, Monte Giano at Antrodoco. Edit ONLY this original photograph. The whole original uncropped frame is 1600 x 1199 pixels, near 4:3. Keep the SAME complete frame and aspect ratio.
ABSOLUTE GEOMETRY LOCK: every mountain ridge, rocky cliff band, central gully, dark planted pine group, diagonal foreground slope at lower left, and every clipped foreground pine branch on the right image edge MUST remain in exactly the original pixel position, scale, silhouette and proportions. Do not redraw the landscape, pan, crop, zoom, change lens, warp or stretch. The low broad plateau crest lies across y=0.32..0.39; the highest flat summit is x=0.55..0.65 around y=0.32. Keep that crest, right shoulder, all cliff bands and left diagonal slope identical. The existing planted pines form the original DVX-shaped pattern on the mountain: retain those SAME existing trees naturally, not new text, not letters overlaid. No new objects, no text, no people, animals, logos, borders or watermarks.
WINTER WITH A VERY HIGH SNOW LINE: white settled snow is restricted STRICTLY to the summit plateau and the highest exposed upper slopes of Monte Giano, a narrow distant summit cap around the top ridge only. Absolutely NO blanket of snow below that summit cap. All lower mountain slopes, cliffs below the cap, wooded hillside, valley, entire foreground diagonal slope, and pine at the right edge remain snow-free. Lower ground is visibly BARE brown earth, rocks, dry muted winter vegetation, leafless existing deciduous trees, with only optional tiny frost on a few twigs. Existing conifers remain dark green with NO blanket of white on their branches. Preserve all trunks and branches. NO white low hills, NO snow-covered foreground, NO continuous white cover below the high summit. This high-altitude snowline rule is the critical acceptance criterion.
Change only season, weather, sky and natural light. Keep authentic texture and camera viewpoint; natural documentary photograph. Return ONE photo.
WEATHER FOR THIS SINGLE VARIANT: CLEAR WINTER MIDDAY: clear blue sky, crisp natural midday sunlight and plausible original-direction shadows. Dry snow-free foreground and lower valley. No fog, clouds, rainfall or falling snow. Only the distant highest summit has a small settled snow cap.

prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: photorealistic weather panorama for an Italian hiking site. EDIT TARGET: Image 1 is the ORIGINAL REAL photograph assets/zones/cicolano-hd.webp of Lago del Salto in Cicolano. Edit this original photograph only. Preserve its COMPLETE EXACT panorama composition and original 1600:482 content ratio (3.3195:1), no crop, zoom, widening, camera movement, warping or stretch. Preserve the precise positions and scale of the long central mountain ridge and summit, every overlapping hill, lake and shoreline contour, peninsulas, tiny villages and roads, the distant horizontal bridge near x=.72 y=.56 and nearer diagonal bridge x=.76 y=.84, left foreground branches, and all bottom foreground. BOTH original side endpoints must remain visible. Change ONLY season, sky, atmospheric weather and corresponding natural lighting/wetness. No added or removed terrain, bridges, buildings, shorelines, foreground or other objects; no people, animals, text, logos or watermark.
WINTER SNOWLINE IS CRITICAL: Snow is allowed ONLY on the UPPER DISTANT MOUNTAINTOPS and their HIGH UPPER SLOPES. The snowy area must end high up on the background mountain; the entire lake valley, all low hills, all peninsulas, shores, villages, bridges, roofs, roads, and ALL foreground and lower forests remain WITHOUT ANY WHITE SNOW BLANKET. Below the high mountain snowline show clearly visible brown-gray bare leafless deciduous vegetation, muted dry grass, dark green evergreen trees and exposed dark earth. Do not paint the low woods white. Winter does NOT mean a blanket of snow on the scene. Keep the lake entirely unfrozen, liquid, and the same water level. No ice or frozen water. No new terrain or features. Preserve believable photographic detail.
WEATHER: CLEAR winter day: crisp clean blue sky, clear distant visibility, natural cool midday sunlight with believable shadows. Small-to-moderate snow patches on the upper distant mountain ridge/high upper slopes only; all lower woodland, foreground and villages are bare snow-free winter colors. No clouds covering the sky, no rain, no fog, no falling snow.
OUTPUT CANVAS TRANSPORT ONLY: Return the complete exact same ultrawide panorama centered inside a 3:1 canvas with PURE WHITE BLANK horizontal padding ABOVE AND BELOW the entire photograph, about 4.81% of canvas height on each side. The content itself must remain 3.3195:1. Do not expand the sky or foreground to fill 3:1; do not crop or resize pieces of the scene. White bands are empty outside-photo transport padding and will be removed; photograph must keep all original scene content and identical framing, ridge scale and bridge positions. No border at left or right.
qa: QA visiva della nuova variante: sovrapposizione al 50% e bordi rosso/ciano contro l’originale; controllati estremi del panorama, scala e profilo delle creste, coste e penisole, centri abitati, ponte orizzontale e ponte diagonale. Neve confinata alle cime e alte pendici lontane; lago liquido, rive, paesi, ponti, colline basse e primo piano senza manto bianco, decidue spoglie ed essenze sempreverdi scure. Meteo distinto e coerente; precipitazioni visibili solo nelle varianti richieste. Rimosse solo fasce bianche vuote esterne di trasporto e ridimensionamento proporzionale a 1600×482. Decodifica completa Pillow superata per finale e bozza, copie byte per byte identiche.
doubts: Il generatore limita la tela a circa 3:1; il panorama integrale è inserito con fasce bianche esterne rimosse dopo la generazione. Ridimensionamento proporzionale, senza crop del paesaggio, deformazione, compositing o ritocco visivo Python.
La QA visiva verifica inquadratura e punti di riferimento; non certifica identità pixel per pixel dei dettagli fini generati.

Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: Fungaroli botanical comparison UI icons, MATCH THE STYLE of the two supplied mushroom reference sheets: clean flat simplified botanical objects, thin dark brown outlines, few solid natural colors, at most subtle single shade, no photographic textures. Produce ONE square PNG sprite sheet 1254x1254, a mathematically regular invisible 3x3 grid of equal square cells. TRUE TRANSPARENT background and gaps; no checkerboard painted in, no panels, no grid lines, no text, letters, digits, arrows, badges or scale bars. Each icon completely contained in its cell with generous margins, centered around the cell center, clear at 48-64px. Reference sheets are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: draw tree characteristics, no mushrooms. Medium muted green foliage and brown twigs. Within a comparison group use EXACTLY the same underlying twig shape, orientation, color and line thickness; vary ONLY the requested character.
Nine icons, row-major order:
Cell0 top-left leaf_kind/aghi: short upright twig with individual narrow needle-shaped green leaves.
Cell1 top-center leaf_kind/squame: cypress spray with tiny overlapping appressed scale leaves tightly hugging branchlets, clearly scale foliage rather than long needles.
Cell2 top-right leaf_kind/foglia_larga: short twig bearing three broad oval green leaves.
Cells3,4,5 and6 are ONE comparison group: same short straight upright brown twig and same needle length/color, needle groups attach directly at visible nodes. Cell3 middle-left singoli: each needle attaches separately to twig, no bundles. Cell4 middle-center a_coppie: exactly TWO needles emerging together from each shared tiny sheath at three separated attachment sites; very clear V-shaped pairs. Cell5 middle-right a_fascetti: exactly FIVE needles radiating from each common sheath at three sites. Cell6 bottom-left a_ciuffi: two or three dense rosettes each with many (about 14) short needles arising from a SINGLE common short spur, like cedar; visibly much denser than five-needle bundles.
Cells7 and8 ONE comparison group: same identical small upright brown twig with three pair attachment sites, same color/thickness. Cell7 bottom-center corti: short straight needles. Cell8 bottom-right lunghi: needles twice as long as cell7, keeping SAME brown twig size and SAME attachment structure. Do not compensate by scaling the twig. All 9 cells occupied.

Use case scientific-educational. Create a 1254x1254 PNG sprite sheet of mushroom trait icons. Image1 is APPROVED base sheet; ONLY its TOP ROW species Amanita phalloides is relevant. Image2 is approved color variant sheet showing target 3x3 LAYOUT with col1 cap-only, col2 whole mushroom, col3 EMPTY TRANSPARENT. Match both images' flat few-color style, thin brown outlines, modest broad highlights, smooth silhouettes and scale EXACTLY. 3 rows, 2 drawings each, total6 icons. TRUE transparent background no text or grid. Row1: phalloides BROWN cap (#8e5f36), same CONVEX shape as base. White gills, stem, pendant ring, sac volva remain unchanged. Row2: phalloides OLIVE GREEN cap (#9a9a5c), young HEMISPHERICAL shape: round dome almost half sphere with inrolled edge, somewhat shorter stem appropriate to age, already visible white pendant ring and white sac volva. Row3: phalloides OLIVE GREEN cap (#9a9a5c), adult FLAT shape: broad almost horizontal flat upper cap with slight central rise, slender adult white stem, same white pendant ring and white sac volva. Smooth caps no warts. Each row column1 shows only cap from side, column2 entire mushroom showing white gills, ring, volva. Keep icons centered at identical LOCAL positions across ALL rows: cap bounding center x224,y269 in each418x418 cell; whole mushroom center x206,y239 in each cell. Cap width~205px, whole mushroom width~214px height~270px; young silhouette appropriately compact but overall matching scale. Third column completely transparent. Do not copy verna or virosa. Only6 icons. No labels, frames, background, glow or shadow.
qa: Controllo visivo di stile, colore, anello, volva e lamelle; alpha reale; terza colonna vuota; allineamento meccanico dei centri alla base senza ricolore o deformazione.
